results.title: GTA 6's Worldwide Release Times Revealed: New Zealand Gets It Nearly a Day Before Some Countries
results.description: GTA 6 players worldwide will receive access at different times when the game launches on November 19. New Zealand will unlock the title first on November 18, while India is expected to get access around 5:30 AM IST on November 19. Rockstar has confirmed India pricing starting at Rs. 5,999 for the Standard Edition.
